{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically too high, especially at longer horizons, showing clear mean-reversion bias away from recent price levels",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) correlates with price stabilization or slight decline, which model doesn't capture",
    "Model under-forecasts price declines more than increases, showing asymmetrical error pattern favoring the upside",
    "Sentiment strength doesn't linearly translate to forecast magnitude - moderate sentiment (0.33-0.67) often yields more accurate forecasts than extreme values",
    "Price levels below 71.5 show more volatility and larger forecast errors, suggesting model confidence decreases at cheaper price levels",
    "Sentiment history length matters - older sentiment signals decay in their predictive value",
    "Model doesn't adequately reflect sentiment reversal dynamics when prices stagnate or decline slowly"
] }
